thesis: Pack's densest pre-open theme is AI datacenter demand: Nvidia says supply is in place for AI demand growth, Nvidia's CEO endorses Marvell, Marvell launches an AI switch, STMicro raises its datacenter target, AMD joins a DriveNets round. Aggressive tier: rotate part of the broad QQQ sleeve into the named beneficiary (NVDA) plus an XLK tech sleeve for breadth, since several catalysts sit in semis/networking names outside the tradable list. Avoiding GOOGL despite the Berkshire $10bn item because the same headline carries an $80bn equity raise (dilution) and a falling stock into the open. Sizing leaves cash and single-name room well inside the 5% floor / 50% name cap / 8-position limits under either plausible open print, so no hindsight sizing and no reject risk.
